players.product: Optical connectors and components for data centers (Intelli-Cross Pro data-center optical connectors, ferrules, MT fiber arrays for optical transceivers), optical connector polishing machines and end-face inspection equipment

quarterly_data.quarter: Seikoh Giken semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-13-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 FY2026 (April - September 2025): net sales JPY 12,133,074 thousand, up 33.9%, and operating profit JPY 2,756,462 thousand, up 167.6%, both first-half records; ordinary profit JPY 2,854,462 thousand (+172.8%); profit attributable to owners of parent JPY 2,229,367 thousand (+188.6%). Optical Products: sales JPY 7,238,288 thousand (+53.2%), operating profit JPY 2,224,653 thousand (+164.6%), both first-half records; management states data-center construction worldwide on the spread of generative AI raised demand for optical communication components such as optical connectors, sharply lifting sales of those components and of optical connector polishing machines and measuring equipment, which drove the profit gain. Precision Machinery: sales JPY 4,894,785 thousand (+12.9%), operating profit JPY 531,809 thousand (+180.9%). The company says it shortened lead times from order to delivery by making automated production equipment in-house, revising staffing and strengthening ties with suppliers and subcontractors.
